newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers only firm, off-peak power Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers only firm, off-peak power Thurs.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) limited its offers for Thursday to 500 megawatts (MW) of firm power during off-peak hours, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA also raised prices for those hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) by $6.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) to $25.00 for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
For Wednesday, BPA had offered up to 400 MW of off-peak firm power and 300 MW of non-firm.
Non-firm prices for Wednesday had ranged from $18.50 to $22.00 per MWh.
